improvements.message: The scoring algorithm could be enhanced by incorporating more advanced engagement metrics, such as sentiment analysis or viewer retention, to improve highlight accuracy.
Consider adding multi-select filters for categories and games to allow users to filter by multiple criteria simultaneously.
Add support for exporting highlights in video formats (e.g., MP4) instead of just JSON, as this would align better with user needs for creating highlight reels.
Upgrade localStorage to IndexedDB for better handling of larger datasets and to future-proof the application for scalability.
Enhance the UI by adding visual indicators (e.g., color-coded scores or tags) to make it easier for users to identify high-priority highlights.
Expand the UX design specification to include mobile responsiveness, as many users may want to access the tool on mobile devices.
Add performance tests to ensure the application remains responsive when handling large datasets.

payload.quality_target: The project meets the stated requirements and is well-structured, but there is room for improvement in advanced features, scalability, and user experience.
